cohort: 30 pregnant women who underwent late cervical cerclage between 2010 and 2016 at Soroka University Medical Center
finding: Late cervical cerclage, performed in a group of women with cervical shortening or dilation beyond 17 weeks of gestation, was found to be a safe procedure resulting in almost 90% of successful vaginal deliveries without maternal or fetal complications.
mod_finding: Late cervical cerclage was found to be a safe procedure, resulting in almost 90% successful vaginal deliveries.
